chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, raising it, concerning the saying:
“Which then of the favors of your Lord will you two deny?”
“Is it with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم or with the Waṣī عليه السلام that you two deny?”
It was revealed in Sūrat al-Raḥmān.

key_terms.آلَاءِ: divine favors or blessings referred to in the verse
key_terms.الرَّحْمَنِ: Sūrat al-Raḥmān, the chapter in which this verse appears
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as one of the referents in this interpretation
key_terms.الْوَصِيِّ: the successor/executor, interpreted here as the divinely designated successor عليه السلام
key_terms.رَبِّكُمَا: your Lord, addressing two parties in the verse

ai.seo_question: How is “فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ” interpreted in Shia hadith regarding the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Waṣī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents a tafsir of the verse “Which then of the favors of your Lord will you two deny?” by relating the divine favor to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Waṣī عليه السلام. It frames the verse in Surah al-Raḥmān as a rebuke against denying these divinely appointed authorities.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad raising,
(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘With regards to the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[55:13] Which then of the Favours of your Lord will you two deny?
Is it with the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> or with the successor<sup>asws</sup> will you two deny?’
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, in a mafu‘ manner, (rafa’ahu) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
(Jinn and mankind) - which of the favors of your Lord do you deny?” [55:13]
Will you deny and refuse the Holy Prophet or his successor.”
(This verse has come down in Ch 55 al-Rahman.)
